entities.name: Bablovia
entities.description: A steampunk 'mad scientist world' plane in the Un-iverse, a pentarchy of five organizations.

entities.name: Carta Scientia
entities.description: The oldest document in Bablovia, which shaped its political structure around the basic sciences.

entities.name: Order of the Widget
entities.description: Cyborgs who use technology to constantly improve themselves.

entities.name: Agents of S.N.E.A.K.
entities.description: Really bad spies with cool toys.

entities.name: League of Dastardly Doom
entities.description: Super villains scheming to take over the world, constantly at odds with each other.

entities.name: Goblin Explosioneers
entities.description: Steamfloggers and tinkerers whose experiments often explode.

entities.name: Crossbreed Labs
entities.description: Creature hybrids who built a society where everyone is their true self.

events.summary: The Carta Scientia establishes governments around the basic sciences, but turns science into a tool to control people.
events.quote: it turned science into a tool to control people

relations.quote: Bablovia is a pentarchy, comprising of five distinct organizations
